facts.description: The English skill text specifies this bonus for water traversal; its exact runtime calculation has not been verified.
The listed milestone halves swimming-related stamina loss.
The described avoidance roll applies to slipping and knock effects.
This is the listed slope traversal bonus, not a measured movement-speed increase.
The bonus concerns vegetation and obstacles; the separate path-creation milestone occurs every three ranks.
The localization assigns a per-rank bonus to fire-starting attempts.
This reduces the described loss rate rather than increasing the amount restored by food.
The description also assigns the same percentage improvement to clothing drying.
Experience-related milestones are separate from this per-rank resource modifier.
The listed capacity increase is additive per skill rank.
The description separately lists melee-range bow use at rank five and an AP-free shot chance at rank ten.
This chance is described as a rank-ten milestone; it is not a per-rank increase.
The English description states this baseline before the skill bonus.
This bonus concerns arrows recovered from corpses.

facts.property: Butchering and skinning AP reduction per rank
facts.description: Additional meat or skin is a separate chance-based benefit.
The description also enables diagonal dodging at rank five.
This is the listed chance modifier for avoiding hostile detection, not a guarantee of invisibility.
The stated bonus applies to equipped armor, not every item carried.
The description associates the chance bonus with blunt melee attacks.
The benefit is described for force-based melee weapons; it is not a flat damage increase.
The rank-ten armor-and-bleeding interaction is a separate milestone.
The skill description requires an equipped shield.
Extra-harvest milestone rolls are distinct from this per-rank modifier.
This chance applies to the skill searches triggered while harvesting or examining plants.
The localization describes four searches at the rank-ten milestone; this is not four guaranteed finds.
The description limits the bonus to greens and lists separate AP-cost milestones.
Ingredient-conservation benefits are separate and are not quantified here.
The described check occurs for poisoned cells at turn start before damage; rank ten adds a further reduction.
